name: simset-glass-004
description: You want to form an amorphous glass: melt a crystal, equilibrate at high T, then quench to low T and relax. Which ensemble sequence is most appropriate?

examples.input:
units real
atom_style atomic
read_data data.crystal

# Suggested high-level sequence of ensembles for melt-quench-glass:
# options (single token): nvt-npt, npt-nvt-npt, nve-nvt, nvt-only
# (token means the sequence of ensembles to apply, e.g. "npt-nvt-npt")
